author: kycrafft
body:
Yes, I know people don't play Nexus a lot but if they do, a lot of people pick engineer. 

Here's the current kit:

Items: Stone sword, full leather, 3 TNT (No cold own when placing!), 5 Landmines
Abilities: Get 1 TNT every 2 kills (?)

First off I want to say that the landmines are actually pretty cool. But when you get five of them, your team can cover half the map on Candoria. Also you can spam the TNT right infront of a player. The TNT will general blow up and push the other TNT's in your direction of you try to run. Great. Well, I am proposing a few changes:

Idea 1:
Items: Gold chestplate, stone sword 3 TNT (no cool down), 2 landmines
Abilities: Get one TNT every 2 kills

or

Idea 2:
Items: Wood sword, full leather, 3 TNT (4 second cool down after placing TNT), 2 landmines
Abilities: Get one TNT every 2 kills, get a landmine every 3 kills

Anyone have any other ideas or see a problem with the ones I've posted?
